abort.reauth_no_username: Could not reauthenticate: this configuration entry has no stored username. Remove the integration and add it again.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid username or password. Note: this integration uses your Panasonic Comfort Cloud account (the same login as the Comfort Cloud app) — not the separate Aquarea Smart Cloud / Aquarea Home app account.
error.mfa_required: This Panasonic ID uses a multi-factor authentication method this integration does not support. Only SMS codes and authenticator app codes work.
error.invalid_mfa_code: The code was not accepted. Check it and try again.
error.mfa_expired: The verification request expired. Enter your password again to get a new code.

data_description.username: Your Panasonic ID, the same login as the Panasonic Comfort Cloud app.
data_description.password: The password for that Panasonic ID.

reauth_confirm.description: Please enter the password for your Panasonic ID {username}:

data_description.password: The current password for this Panasonic ID.

mfa_sms.description: Panasonic sent a verification code by SMS to {destination}. Enter it below. To get a new code, tick "Send a new code" and submit.

data_description.code: The 6-digit code. A recovery code works as well.
data_description.resend_code: Tick this to have Panasonic send the SMS again; the code field can stay empty.

mfa_otp.description: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

data_description.code: The 6-digit code. A recovery code works as well.

init.description: Warning: Setting the refresh interval too low can cause your IP to be banned from Panasonic Cloud.

data_description.consumption_interval: How often to fetch energy consumption from the Panasonic cloud, in minutes (minimum 10). Device state is refreshed every minute regardless of this setting.
